g.text: Legal curb by block face in the corridor, from the City's sign inventory
Each side of each street segment, drawn offset from the centre line. Blue: curb where no sign forbids stopping or parking at all times;
orange: stretches where such signs apply. Each face stops 10 m short of each intersection, as measured. Rue de Terrebonne: one parking band, south side west of Cavendish, north side east of it.
Corridor: 37.2 km of legal curb on 318 block faces (8 % of the curb net of 10 m at each end is forbidden at all times). Upper bound: driveways,
hydrants, bus stops, hourly and permit rules are not deducted.
Sources: SAAQ, vehicles released under the access Act (file 03.06.34729), December 31, 2024, type inferred; Statistics Canada, 2021 Census;
City of Montréal, géobase, parking-sign inventory and assessment roll (CC BY 4.0). Automobiles below the FSA are MODELLED, not measured.
